title: Media Block
description: A standalone media section with optional caption and link. Supports DAM-backed (DynamicImage) or manually-authored (ManualImage) media.

href.title: Link
href.description: Optional URL — wraps the media in a link. External URLs open in a new tab.

fullBleed.title: Full bleed
fullBleed.description: Extend the media edge-to-edge, ignoring container padding and max-width.

maxWidth.title: Max width
maxWidth.description: Ignored when full bleed is on.
